sourceDescription: Starter capability map for a Scottish local authority (a council under the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994), drafted 2026-09-07 from general familiarity with the reference models named in sources.md; nothing is copied verbatim. Two levels: eight capabilities shared with every other map (codes 1-8, identical wording) plus four Scotland-specific ones (Curriculum for Excellence, Integration Joint Boards, Council Tax Reduction, the Scottish Welfare Fund). Reviewed by Simon Parkinson and published 2026-09-08. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

sources.citation: Socitm Local Public Services Business Capability Model (consulted for scope and level-1 shape; not copied)
Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994 and the Public Bodies (Joint Working) (Scotland) Act 2014 (statutory duties consulted for sector-specific capabilities)
UK Government Functional Standards GovS 001-016 (consulted for the shared corporate capabilities)
